verdict.rationale: Honeybadger's Cocoa reference says that once installed it will "automatically report crashes and errors in your app," which is first-party evidence of iOS/Apple native crash capture. Nothing in the pack covers Android or NDK, or confirms that device, OS, and app-version context is attached to crash reports. missing for 10: Android crash reporting, NDK/native C/C++ crash capture, documented device/OS/app-version context on mobile crashes, mobile symbolication details, independent or hands-on corroboration of mobile crash capture.
